name: ApexVibe Music Bot
description: Lightweight Telegram voice-chat music bot with fast YouTube playback and bounded clone workers

STRING_SESSION.description: Parent assistant Pyrogram string session for voice-chat streaming

MONGO_DB_URI.description: MongoDB URI for encrypted clone-user backup across restarts

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Parent bot log group or channel ID

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key for faster music search

YT_COOKIES.description: Optional raw Netscape cookies, base64 cookies, or private HTTPS cookies URL

CLONE_USERS_LOG.description: Private Telegram group/channel ID receiving one complete safe clone audit message per event
